policy: Generated backlog is assignment data. null acceptance means not assessed. A phase gate requires all phase tasks, evidence and review; done inventory does not pass a phase.

current_backlog.role: Revised assignment after the P0 gate. For tasks that are not started, its acceptance, verification, delivery_slice, measurement and evidence_tier_min fields are authoritative; refresh the tracker criterion when a task starts.

tiers.A: Tracker entry with commands, tests and result plus checks.json written by tools/dev/check.py.
tiers.B: Tier A plus risk-selected sanitizer results and a short ownership, lifetime or concurrency note.
tiers.C: Full reviewed package: anonymized metadata, raw reports kept outside the repository, decision record.

evidence_policy.tier_selection: Use at least the backlog evidence_tier_min. Raise to B when the change touches native resources, threads, queues, callbacks or stop/cancel paths. Phase gates and tasks with measurement are C.
evidence_policy.tracker_entry: New entries reference the evidence directory and its checks.json instead of listing every file; list individual files only for criteria that need a specific artifact.
evidence_policy.historical_entries: Entries completed before this policy keep their detailed evidence lists.

verification_policy.every_change: Whitespace, clang-format on changed native sources, release build and CTest excluding the long PTS conformance label.
verification_policy.phase_gate: Run tools/dev/check.py --gate for the full matrix.
verification_policy.unavailable_checks: A report with unavailable checks is incomplete, not passed, and must be reported as such.

measurement_policy: Run reference series or benchmarks only for tasks whose backlog measurement field is reference-series or benchmark. Other tasks use correctness tests and make no performance claim.

delivery_slices.policy: A slice is delivered in one commit that closes all of its task IDs; each ID keeps its own acceptance, evidence and status. Phases without slices deliver one task ID per commit.
